# BoolBul (https://boolbul.com)
> In-app cancellation flow for indie SaaS: exit survey, pause and discount offers, and an always-visible cancel link. Supports Dodo Payments and Stripe. Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar and Chargebee are coming soon.

## How it works
1. Your cancel button calls `BoolBul.open(...)` (script tag or `@boolbul/sdk`).
2. The customer answers a one-tap exit survey and sees reason-matched offers (discount or pause).
3. If they accept, the edge signs a 5-minute single-use `offerJwt` with YOUR signing secret.
4. Your server verifies it with `@boolbul/sdk/server` and applies it with Dodo Payments or Stripe. BoolBul never sees gateway keys.
5. If BoolBul doesn't answer within 1.5s, `onCancel` runs (fail-open). The cancel link is on every screen (FTC 16 CFR 425 / California ARL).

## Client
- Script: `<script src="https://boolbul.com/v1/boolbul.js"></script>` then `BoolBul.open({ publicKey, customerId, subscriptionId, mrrCents, onOfferAccepted, onCancel, onDismiss })`
- npm: `@boolbul/sdk` (`open`, `preview`), `@boolbul/sdk/react` (`useBoolBul`, `BoolBulPreview`)
- `onOfferAccepted({ offerJwt, offerType: "discount"|"pause", offerValue, discountDurationMonths, reasonId })` — POST offerJwt to your server; throw to show a retry.
- `onCancel({ reasonId, comment, failedOpen })` — run your normal cancellation.
- reasonId values equal Dodo `cancellation_feedback` and Stripe `cancellation_details.feedback`: too_expensive, unused, missing_features, switched_service, customer_service, low_quality, too_complex, other.

## Server (`@boolbul/sdk/server`, zero dependencies)
- `redeemOffer(offerJwt, { signingSecret, expected: { subscriptionId }, seenNonce?, gateway })`
- gateway: `{ gateway: "dodo_payments", apiKey, environment: "test_mode"|"live_mode" }` or `{ gateway: "stripe", secretKey }`
- `cancelSubscription(subscriptionId, gateway, { reasonId, comment, immediately? })`
- Dodo pause = move next_billing_date (or native status "paused"); Stripe pause = pause_collection with resumes_at. Discounts = single-use code/coupon.

## Mobile
- WebView URL: `https://boolbul.com/w/<publicKey>?customerId=…&subscriptionId=…&mrrCents=…`
- Messages: `boolbul:offer_accepted` (offer.offerJwt), `boolbul:cancel` (details), `boolbul:dismiss` via ReactNativeWebView, webkit.messageHandlers.boolbul, BoolBulNative channel, flutter_inappwebview, or parent.postMessage.

## Public endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/widget-config/<publicKey>` — widget design (60s CDN cache)
- `POST /api/v1/intercept/init` — open a session
- `POST /api/v1/intercept/claim` — sign an accepted offer
- `POST /api/v1/intercept/outcome` — shown / cancelled beacon
